viewing_check: Estimate 30-50, current bid $10 (+22% premium). About 18 small Wade Ireland pieces, mostly mugs with hunting scenes. Individual mugs sold $5-32, small and common ones $5-18, large tankards $18-32, steady 2024-2026. Check for chips, crazing and cracks in the glaze, which kill value. 18 pieces at $5-30 is about $150-250 gross if sold individually, but heavy and fragile to post and time-consuming to list.
